```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_bw())

qc <- read_tsv(
  "../output/qc/sample_qc_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    rrna_mean_pct = (rrna_r1_pct + rrna_r2_pct) / 2,
    hbrna_mean_pct = (hbrna_r1_pct + hbrna_r2_pct) / 2
  )
```

# Overview

```{r overview}
tibble(
  samples = nrow(qc),
  individuals = n_distinct(qc$individual)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# QC Summary

```{r summary}
qc |>
  summarise(
    mapping_median = median(mapping_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    decoy_median = median(decoy_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    compatible_median = median(library_compatible_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    fragment_length_median = median(fragment_length_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    rrna_median = median(rrna_mean_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    hbrna_median = median(hbrna_mean_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2
  )
```

# QC Visualisations {.tabset}

## Mapping Rate

```{r mapping}
qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  mutate(sample_order = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(sample_order, mapping_rate)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples",
    y = "Salmon Mapping Rate (%)"
  )
```

## Decoy Alignment

```{r decoy}
qc |>
  arrange(decoy_pct) |>
  mutate(sample_order = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(sample_order, decoy_pct)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples",
    y = "Decoy Fragments (%)"
  )
```

## Mapping vs Decoy

```{r mapping-decoy}
qc |>
  ggplot(
    aes(decoy_pct, mapping_rate)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Decoy Fragments (%)",
    y = "Salmon Mapping Rate (%)"
  )
```

## Library Compatibility

```{r compatibility}
qc |>
  arrange(library_compatible_pct) |>
  mutate(sample_order = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(sample_order, library_compatible_pct)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples",
    y = "Library-Compatible Fragments (%)"
  )
```


# Lowest Mapping Samples

```{r low-mapping}
qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  select(
    run,
    individual,
    timepoint,
    mapping_rate,
    decoy_pct,
    library_compatible_pct,
    rrna_mean_pct,
    hbrna_mean_pct
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2
  )
```
